scientific_findings.assessment: Calling update-22/23/27 measured endpoints late-window samples is incorrect: their matched endpoints are 0.23/0.24/0.28 s, before the sampled 0.30-0.35 s holding window. Individual cited values are exact; their prose time classification is wrong.

The blanket unread-before-about-0.30-s wording overlooks measured endpoints returned by prediction reads at 0.20-0.29 s. The corrected structured gap basis explicitly records these reads, but limitations and final prose retain the broader claim. Unreturned force/tracking channels remain a separate field-coverage issue.

Comparing displacement differences directly with scaled integration step residuals does not establish endpoint numerical resolution. Comparing displacements at 0.008 and 0.010 s is also not the stated matched endpoint-speed criterion. The retained result does supply unequal endpoint speeds and distinct inputs, but neither establishes global endpoint braking optimality or cancels shared model error.
The input-box solution is analytic; the trajectories are numerical implicit-Euler rollouts. Calling them two analytic rollouts is inaccurate.
